kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Aramaic חרּד (ḥarrēd)der.
Aramaic חַרְדּוֹנ (ḥardōn)der.
Arabic حرذون
Derived from Aramaic חַרְדּוֹנ (ḥardōn, “crocodile; large lizard”), cognates with ܚܲܪܕܵܢܵܐ (ḥarḏōnā), Hebrew חַרְדּוֹן (ḥardôn); ultimately from Aramaic חרּד (ḥarrēd, “to terrify”).
g: agama; members of Agamidae, dragon lizards
